content: {"reasoning": "CO-97 means the service is bundled into another paid service and not separately payable. This is a bundling denial, not a documentation or authorization issue. The proper response is a formal appeal arguing the service was separately payable/medically necessary, supported by documentation (quality 0.85 is decent). Prior auth isn't required, so retro-auth is irrelevant. An appeal with medical necessity is the appropriate path to challenge the bundling determination.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
